primary_contrast: varied versus fixed, new start-goal combinations; strict success and supported pickup/placement/yaw components
secondary: recovery versus fixed, original sources and diagnostic failure-state panel; extra goal/loading tests exploratory
limitations: six previously seen source take families, not independent new recordings. Original A and loading task template were previously inspected; new goal combination split frozen before fit. One seed per training recipe. Hypothesis-generating, not claimed powered confirmation.
scope: Counterfactual feeding-goal diversity; successful geometric teacher labels, no directly aligned phone robot actions. DAgger-style is one offline aggregation, not PPO.
